notes: Covers the 2015 Mesa 2, from one spec page for that year; other Mesa models and years may differ. The page says 7-speed in the chain and cassette rows but 21-speed in its feature text, and V-brake in one place and linear-pull in another.

gaps: Chain and cassette rows say 7-speed, but a features bullet says "21-speed drivetrain"; no total gear count is claimed.
The brakes row says alloy V-brake, but a features bullet says alloy linear-pull; brakes are not listed (the template has no brake part).
The SR Suntour M3020 suspension fork (63 mm travel) is not listed as a part; the page gives no spring type.
Only the 2015 Mesa 2 page was read.
method: Specs are from the BikeRoar spec page "Schwinn Mesa 2 (2015) Specs".
The researcher reported HTTP 429 from Schwinn and Mongoose pages, a bot check on Walmart, and HTTP 403 from 99spokes; none are cited.

comps.spec: KMC Z51 chain, listed as 7-speed; alloy MTB crankset, 42/34/24T; SunRace 14-34 cassette, listed as 7-speed
Shimano Tourney rear derailleur, shifted by SRAM MRX grip shifters
Schwinn MTB trail aluminium frame (frame-type line ends in 26; tyres are 26 x 2.1)
